title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: breakout room support
summary: Hold: the statement that no prerequisite or role is published is too broad. Microsoft documents the Android app update introducing support and explicitly names meeting organisers as the people assigning and moving devices; the rollout dates, default and PowerShell control otherwise check out.

### 1449/1.0.96.2026344105 (November 2026)
Introduced in this update: ... Breakout rooms support: Teams Rooms on Android devices can join a breakout room

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls; rendered controls table
claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowBreakoutRooms $false disables breakout-room functionality.
claims.quote: Module: MicrosoftTeams PowerShell module ... -AllowBreakoutRooms: Set to true to enable Breakout Rooms, set to false to disable the Breakout Rooms functionality. ... -Identity: Specify the name of the policy being created.
claims.fix: Keep the command. Add this sentence to Governance controls: 'Learn's Plan for Teams meetings comparison lists breakout rooms as having "No control" for admins, whereas the PowerShell reference documents AllowBreakoutRooms.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/plan-meetings#admin-and-meeting-organizer-meeting-options.
